dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual geometric convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-back toward a narrow, pointed posterior termination.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity median pixel value consistent with a mature white skin tone across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A thin, dark longitudinal linear feature is visible along the central dorsal axis, containing localized clusters of high-contrast dark pixels.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle shadow-casting along the longitudinal dorsal mark suggests a slight topological depression relative to the surrounding plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark-pigmented longitudinal scar or scrape extending along the mid-dorsal ridge.
